desc:
• GLUTEN FREE: Tasty gummy treats made without gluten or gelatin; Each serving has a good source of vitamin C for snacks you can feel great about

  • FRUIT FLAVORED SNACKS: Fruit Roll-Ups Variety Pack featuring Strawberry Blast, Tropical Tie-Dye, and Blue Razzberry flavors. With wild flavors and colors, the possibilities for fun are endless

  • FUN KIDS SNACK: These individually wrapped snacks are the perfect treat to include in a packed school lunch box; Each roll comes with an assortment of tongue tattoos for wacky fun

  • ON THE GO SNACK: These Fruit Flavored Snacks are the perfect addition to your pantry and a snack every member of the family will love

  • CONTAINS: One 5 oz Variety Pack of Fruit Roll-Ups Fruit Flavored Snacks; 10 Ct
features:
Key Features

Gluten‑ and gelatin‑free: Suitable for those with gluten sensitivities and designed with preservative-free, fun gummy textures .

Vitamin C fortified: Provides 10% of daily value per roll—making it a snack you can feel good about .

Individually wrapped rolls: Comes with 10 single‑serve pouches—perfect for lunch boxes, on‑the‑go treats, or portion control .

Flavor variety: Includes Strawberry Blast, Tropical Tie‑Dye, and Blue Razzberry—bright colors, bold flavors, and creative options .

Tongue tattoos included: Each roll comes with a fun edible tongue tattoo—adds playfulness to snack time .

No high-fructose corn syrup or artificial flavors: Crafted without gluten, gelatin, or artificial flavors, aligning with simpler ingredient preferences . 

 Benefits

Kid-friendly and fun: Bright colors + tongue tattoos = an engaging snack kids enjoy and remember. Perfect for lunch, after school, or rewards.

Snacking made simple: Individually wrapped, single‑serve pouches make packing easy, and they’re mess‑free.

Better-for-you treat: Comes with vitamin C, no gluten or gelatin, and free from artificial flavors—balances fun with a slightly healthier profile.

Portable and convenient: Lightweight and resealable, making them great for travel, backpacks, or gym bags.

Creative enjoyment: Versatile – eat them straight, wrap them around fruit or ice cream, or freeze for a cold snack .
ingredients: Corn Syrup, Sugar, Pear Puree, Maltodextrin, Palm and/or Palm Kernel Oil. Contains 2% or less of: Citric Acid, Sodium Citrate, Monoglycerides, Fruit Pectin, Malic Acid, Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), Natural Flavor, Color (red 40, yellows 5 & 6, blue 1).
